messages:
Maya: Heads-up — Phalanx (customer) reporting spiky 5xxs on their dedicated pool since ~03:20 UTC. CS flagged this as P1. We need owners for mitigation, routing fallback, and a short workaround timeline.
Diego: I can own short-term mitigation. Need eng-platform to confirm routing fallback and infra to confirm pool capacity.
Sofia: I can take routing. Current canary sends ~2% traffic to model v2. Diverting Phalanx back to v1 should remove the errors but might add ~30-50ms.
Ben: Seeing CPU + KV-cache pressure on node group phi-3. Prewarming cache and will bump replica +1. Planning rolling restart in ~10m.
Maya: OK owners: Diego (mitigation/hotpatch), Sofia (routing), Ben (infra). CS needs an ETA for a customer-facing update.
Diego: Mitigation plan: 1) divert phalanx -> v1 (Sofia) 2) short client-side retry (30s) via ops-bot 3) hotpatch KV guard in ~1h. I'll open the CR now.
Sofia: I can flip routing as soon as Ben confirms prewarm. Routing flag: phalanx_force_model=v1. Command I'll run: ```kubectl exec router -- /bin/sh -c 'toggle-route phalanx --to v1 --dry-run=false'```
Ben: Prewarm done, starting rolling restart now. Will post when replica is ready and metrics stable. Node group phi-3 -> +1 replica.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary toggle request queued by Sofia. ETA to apply once infra ready: ~90s.
deploy-bot: Diego opened PR: github.com/redwood/infra/pull/5123. Tagging @Ben @Sofia for review so hotpatch can go after rollback.
Sofia: Reviewed and approved the PR, pushing routing change now.
Maya: Please confirm when routing is live so I can notify CS. Also include an SLO-impact blurb.
router: routing change applied for customer=phalanx -> model=v1; change_id=chg_20260317_01
Ben: Replica is ready. After prewarm CPU is back to normal and KV miss rate dropped. p99 latency increased ~40ms but error rate is down.
Diego: Hotpatch job scheduled in CI for 00:40 UTC. If rollback holds, we'll run a postmortem and schedule long-term fixes.
Sofia: Monitoring shows error rate for Phalanx dropped from ~2.4% to ~0.2% after the divert. Dash looks stable.
Ava: I'm on-call, joining the bridge in ~5m to help with customer comms and the CS note. Do we want a dedicated Sev channel?
Maya: Yes — opening #sev-phalanx now and will post a short customer note in 15m: problem summary, mitigation, hotpatch ETA, next steps. Assigning postmortem to Diego + Ben. :thumbsup:
Diego: Thanks — I'll start drafting RCA checklist and capture logs for KV eviction pattern.
Ben: Will attach node metrics and restart timeline to the PR.
Maya: Great. Keep updates short in this thread; we only escalate to broader channels if things change.
__notes: Generated synthetic Slack thread for cross-team escalation and ownership.
